subject: REDEFINES clause
notes: kb/Work PB1280 (wave 1011 B2). cite.py --check 13.18.44.3 'The description of the subject of the entry shall be such that its required alignment is the same as the alignment' OK SR15. Determination: the subject's required alignment is a byte boundary unless it is a bit item placed by 8.5.1.6.3 rule 1 (the next bit position); a subject that needs a byte boundary over a data-name-2 that begins mid-byte (BitLayout.StartBitOf) has no storage association 13.18.44.4 GR1 can make ('starts at the first bit of the data item referenced by data-name-2'); COBOL2739. A bit-aligned subject fits any bit; a character subject over a bit item that begins a byte is legal (positive golden).
